# 00_preliminaries.sh - Prepare a parallel scanner step

## Description

First command of each parallel scanner step in `1-populate-from-icpsr`. The Download step hands the deposit ZIP to later steps through the `cache/` artifact; this script moves `cache/<projectID>.zip` back into the working directory, so that [00_unpack_zip.sh](#help-00_unpack_zip) can unpack it.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/00_preliminaries.sh <yes|no> <projectID>
```

- First argument - The step's `Process*` switch (for example `$ProcessStata`). When it is `no`, the script exits without doing anything.
- `projectID` - Deposit directory name; the ZIP is expected at `cache/<projectID>.zip`.

## Notes

- It lists the contents of `cache/` for the pipeline log.
- It also sets a `pythonbin` variable, but because the script runs in its own shell, that variable is not visible to the commands that follow it.
